thread.title: iPhone Suppliers May Move From China If Tariffs Get Too High, Sources Say - Bloomberg

author: morningstar.com
title: iPhone Suppliers May Move From China If Tariffs Get Too High, Sources Say - Bloomberg
text:
-- Suppliers for Apple Inc. (AAPL) iPhones may move production away from China if tariffs rise to 25% on U.S. imports, Bloomberg reports Wednesday, citing "people familiar with the company's thinking."
-- If tariffs rise to 10% on smartphones, suppliers may remain in China, but if tariffs hit 25% they may reconsider the situation, the report said.
Full story: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-12-12/apple-is-said-to-mull-moving-iphone-output-if-tariffs-hit-25
